g.text: Bitloom is fully usable without a mouse. Section keys work while a table,
tree or log has focus; typing in a field never triggers them.
Move focus between fields, tables and logs
Focus the filter or search field of this section (nano:
Leave a field and return to the section list
Open / select the highlighted row; run from a field
Move down / up in tables, trees and logs
Edit the build target (when no section uses t)
